########################################################################
# Setup library
########################################################################
include(GNUInstallDirs)

list(APPEND harogic_sg_sources
    sink_impl.cc
    h2_device.cc)

set(harogic_sg_sources
    "${harogic_sg_sources}"
    PARENT_SCOPE)
if(NOT harogic_sg_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ sources... skipping lib/")
    return()
endif(NOT harogic_sg_sources)

add_library(gnuradio-harogic_sg SHARED ${harogic_sg_sources})
########################################################################
# Harogic H2 API (SG_Linux_API -> install_h2_lib.sh installs it in /opt/h2api)
########################################################################
string(TOLOWER "${CMAKE_SYSTEM_PROCESSOR}" H2_PROC)
if(H2_PROC MATCHES "^(aarch64|arm64)$")
    set(H2_ARCH aarch64)
elseif(H2_PROC MATCHES "^(armv7l|armv7|armhf)$")
    set(H2_ARCH armv7)
else()
    set(H2_ARCH x86_64)
endif()
set(H2API_ROOT "/opt/h2api" CACHE PATH "Harogic H2 API install root")
find_path(H2API_INCLUDE_DIR h2_api.h
    HINTS ${H2API_ROOT}/inc ${H2API_ROOT}/include /usr/local/include /usr/include)
find_library(H2API_LIBRARY NAMES h2api
    HINTS ${H2API_ROOT}/lib/${H2_ARCH} ${H2API_ROOT}/lib /usr/local/lib /usr/lib)
if(NOT H2API_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT H2API_LIBRARY)
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "Harogic H2 API not found (h2_api.h / libh2api.so). Install SG_Linux_API "
        "(sudo sh install_h2_lib.sh) or pass -DH2API_ROOT=<dir>.")
endif()
message(STATUS "H2 API: ${H2API_LIBRARY} (headers ${H2API_INCLUDE_DIR})")
get_filename_component(H2API_LIBRARY_DIR "${H2API_LIBRARY}" DIRECTORY)

target_link_libraries(gnuradio-harogic_sg gnuradio::gnuradio-runtime ${H2API_LIBRARY})
target_include_directories(gnuradio-harogic_sg PRIVATE ${H2API_INCLUDE_DIR})
set_target_properties(gnuradio-harogic_sg PROPERTIES
    INSTALL_RPATH "${H2API_LIBRARY_DIR}" BUILD_RPATH "${H2API_LIBRARY_DIR}")
target_include_directories(
    gnuradio-harogic_sg
    PUBLIC $<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../include>
    PUBLIC $<INSTALL_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_INSTALL_INCLUDEDIR}>)
set_target_properties(gnuradio-harogic_sg PROPERTIES DEFINE_SYMBOL "gnuradio_harogic_sg_EXPORTS")

if(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(gnuradio-harogic_sg PROPERTIES INSTALL_NAME_DIR
                                                    "${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}/lib")
endif(APPLE)

########################################################################
# Install built library files
########################################################################
include(GrMiscUtils)
gr_library_foo(gnuradio-harogic_sg)

########################################################################
# Print summary
########################################################################
message(STATUS "Using install prefix: ${CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX}")
message(STATUS "Building for version: ${VERSION} / ${LIBVER}")

########################################################################
# Build and register unit test
########################################################################
include(GrTest)

# If your unit tests require special include paths, add them here
#include_directories()
# List all files that contain Boost.UTF unit tests here
list(APPEND test_harogic_sg_sources)
# Anything we need to link to for the unit tests go here
list(APPEND GR_TEST_TARGET_DEPS gnuradio-harogic_sg)

if(NOT test_harogic_sg_sources)
    message(STATUS "No C++ unit tests... skipping")
    return()
endif(NOT test_harogic_sg_sources)

foreach(qa_file ${test_harogic_sg_sources})
    gr_add_cpp_test("harogic_sg_${qa_file}" ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${qa_file})
endforeach(qa_file)
